items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Kevin; Kevin identifies himself as the interviewer.

ctx.x: Well, we have another one now. And now my sister was here today. She saw the large medium. She said, well, where did you get that at? She said, don't you have another one? I said, I have the old one. Well, what do you want to do with two of them? Now she's trying to get one, you see. Yeah, we'll give it that one. No, this one's for my little sister.
Oh, that's the other one. That's the younger sister. I'll get you another print. I have another print. I'm Kevin.
Okay. You know, there was another picture of the Pure List band. It was a different drummer, though.
